---
title: "Handbook on utilising new data sources in the production of consumer price statistics"
---

::: {.callout-note title="Pilot migration in progress"}
This site is a work-in-progress migration of the UN Task Team
[handbook](https://unstats.un.org/wiki/spaces/GWGSD/pages/240910447/Handbook+on+utilising+new+data+sources+in+the+production+of+consumer+price+statistics)
from the UN Statistics Confluence wiki to Quarto, so the handbook can be
version-controlled and maintained on GitHub. Two example pages — chosen because
they are heavy in both LaTeX formulas and images — have been converted first to
validate rendering fidelity before the full migration.
:::

## Pilot pages

- [Extension methods](extension-methods.qmd) — extending multilateral price
  indices (splicing methods); formula- and figure-heavy.
- [How to evaluate classification methods](how-to-evaluate-classification-methods.qmd)
  — evaluation metrics for product classification; formulas and figures.

## Source

Content originates from the Confluence space export of the GWGSD handbook.
The remaining pages will be migrated with the same tooling (see `scripts/convert_page.py`)
once the pilot rendering is signed off.
